#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Deterministic PRIVATE control for supervise_pa19_v6.py (v5 delayed reap + signal-blocked finalization); not production
coverage. All v5 cases are re-run against v6; P5/P6 inject a SIGTERM while the completion record is being opened (the
finalization window): v5 reproduces the reviewed defect (written record clean, returned observed_signal set, outer
handler never called); v6 must write and return identical records and deliver the signal to the restored outer handler.
The 08:45 record signature ('leader exits, first poll None') is reproduced by injection, not by the live kernel race:
the exact retained Popen is an instrumented subclass whose first N poll() calls return None WITHOUT waitpid. Events
inside the delayed-reap window are injected deterministically from inside poll(): a SIGTERM to this control process
(the supervisor's own handler records it), a statvfs shim reporting 0 free bytes, a probe wrapper reporting RSS above
the cap or an 'unknown' leader. The pinned v3/v5 files are loaded unchanged; only module-global names `subprocess`/`os`
are replaced for the duration of one case. One lane token is held (metadata Capacity); children are
`python -I -B -c ...`, never setuid; the only group signal is the adapter's own stop while the leader is unreaped.
After each case the control reaps the child (Popen.wait, no timeout) only when it is known exited.
Cases (expected):
  A  v3 inject1 exit0                    unclean, rc None, one poll (the production signature)
  B  v5 inject1 exit0                    clean rc0: the next real poll (after the safety checks) observed the exit
  C  v5 never reapable                   unclean rc None; polls stop by the 5 s bound (span <= 5.002 s)
  D  v5 inject1 exit3                    unclean rc3
  E  v5 no injection exit0               clean rc0
  G  v5 inject1 wall trip (monitor)      'wall cap', one poll, unclean        H  v3 same: same outcome
  I  v5 SIGTERM inside delayed reap      'external SIGTERM during delayed reap', stop while unreaped, observed_signal
  J  v5 wall exceeded inside delayed reap   'wall cap ... during delayed reap', unclean
  K  v5 floor breached inside delayed reap  'free bytes 0 below floor ... during delayed reap', unclean
  L  v5 RSS above cap inside delayed reap   'aggregate RSS ... during delayed reap', unclean
  M  v5 unknown leader inside delayed reap  uncertain trip + quarantine, unclean
  N  v5 SIGTERM right after the reap        'external SIGTERM before the completion record', no stop after reaping
"""
import builtins
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import os
import signal
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import types
from pathlib import Path

import m2_supervised_runtime_v6 as R6

L = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
PINS = {'v3':('src/supervise_pa19_v3.py','79c463589c9c5d60fddff7c4397a4e90339bdb0f5a0b2542c865c02a387573b3'),
        'v5':('src/supervise_pa19_v5.py','a7540cded7c485491d30e364afd09663b5d02b315232ec38d8f50f3d82a6bbf5'),
        'v6':('src/supervise_pa19_v6.py',None)}
CAP = R6.GROUP_RSS_CAP


def digest(p):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def load(label,sha):
    rel = PINS[label][0]
    assert digest(L/rel) == sha, ('pinned supervisor changed',rel)
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('control_supervise6_'+label,str(L/rel))
    mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
    return mod


class Instrumented(subprocess.Popen):
    def __init__(self,*args,plan=None,**kwargs):
        self.plan, self.calls = plan or {}, []
        super().__init__(*args,**kwargs)

    def poll(self):
        t, n = time.monotonic(), len(self.calls)
        if n == 0 and self.plan.get('trigger') is not None: self.plan['trigger'][0] = True
        if self.plan.get('signal_at_call') == n: os.kill(os.getpid(),signal.SIGTERM)
        if n < self.plan.get('inject',0):
            self.calls.append({'t':t,'returned':None,'injected':True})
            return None
        rc = super().poll()
        self.calls.append({'t':t,'returned':rc,'injected':False})
        if rc is not None and self.plan.get('signal_on_reap') and not self.plan.get('sent'):
            self.plan['sent'] = True; os.kill(os.getpid(),signal.SIGTERM)
        return rc


class OsShim:
    """Real os except statvfs, which reports 0 free bytes once the trigger is set."""
    def __init__(self,trigger): self.trigger = trigger
    def __getattr__(self,name): return getattr(os,name)
    def statvfs(self,path):
        st = os.statvfs(path)
        return types.SimpleNamespace(f_bavail=0,f_frsize=st.f_frsize) if self.trigger[0] else st


def run_case(out,name,mod,label,sha,code,plan,wall,grace=10.0,floor_shim=False,probe_mode=None,record_open_signal=False):
    made, trigger, outer = [], [False], []
    plan = dict(plan); plan['trigger'] = trigger

    def factory(*args,**kwargs):
        p = Instrumented(*args,plan=plan,**kwargs); made.append(p); return p
    real_probe = mod.probe

    def probe_fn(pid,pidinfo=None):
        st,rss,ident = real_probe(pid,pidinfo)
        if trigger[0] and probe_mode == 'rss' and pid == os.getpid(): return st,CAP+1,ident
        if trigger[0] and probe_mode == 'unknown' and made and pid == made[0].pid: return 'unknown',0,{}
        return st,rss,ident
    record_path = str(out/(name+'.supervisor.json'))
    def opener(path,mode='r',*a,**k):
        if record_open_signal and path == record_path and mode == 'x': os.kill(os.getpid(),signal.SIGTERM)
        return builtins.open(path,mode,*a,**k)
    prev_term = signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM,lambda s,f: outer.append(time.monotonic()))
    mod.open = opener
    saved = (mod.subprocess,mod.os)
    mod.subprocess = types.SimpleNamespace(Popen=factory,DEVNULL=subprocess.DEVNULL)
    if floor_shim: mod.os = OsShim(trigger)
    owned = []
    try:
        rec = mod.supervise([sys.executable,'-I','-B','-c',code],'CONTROL5-'+name,wall,CAP,R6.FLOOR,str(L),
                            str(out/(name+'.supervisor.json')),str(out/(name+'.quarantine.json')),grace=grace,
                            probe_fn=probe_fn,owner_child=owned)
    finally:
        mod.subprocess,mod.os = saved
        del mod.open
        signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM,prev_term)
    assert len(made) == 1 and owned == made, 'exact retained Popen not observed'
    child = made[0]; calls = list(child.calls)
    state_now = real_probe(child.pid)[0] if child.returncode is None else 'reaped'
    reaped = child.returncode if child.returncode is not None else (child.wait() if state_now in ('zombie','gone') else None)
    real = [c for c in calls if not c['injected']]
    return {'case':name,'module':label,'module_sha256':sha,'child_code':code,'inject':'all' if plan.get('inject',0) >= 10**6 else plan.get('inject',0),
            'events':{k:plan.get(k) for k in ('signal_at_call','signal_on_reap') if plan.get(k) is not None} or None,
            'floor_shim':floor_shim,'probe_mode':probe_mode,'wall_seconds':wall,
            'record':str((out/(name+'.supervisor.json')).relative_to(L)),'record_sha256':digest(out/(name+'.supervisor.json')),
            'completed_cleanly':rec['completed_cleanly'],'leader_returncode':rec['leader_returncode'],'trip_reason':rec['trip_reason'],
            'uncertain':rec['uncertain'],'quarantine_record':rec['quarantine_record'],'stop_ran':rec.get('stop') is not None,
            'observed_signal':rec.get('observed_signal'),'poll_calls':len(calls),'injected_calls':len(calls)-len(real),
            'first_real_offset_s':round(real[0]['t']-calls[0]['t'],4) if real and calls else None,
            'last_returned':calls[-1]['returned'] if calls else None,'poll_span_s':round(calls[-1]['t']-calls[0]['t'],4) if calls else None,
            'reaped_by_control_or_record_returncode':reaped,'leader_state_after_case':state_now,'outer_handler_calls':len(outer),
            'written_equals_returned':json.loads((out/(name+'.supervisor.json')).read_bytes()) == json.loads(json.dumps(rec)),
            'written_observed_signal':json.loads((out/(name+'.supervisor.json')).read_bytes()).get('observed_signal'),
            'written_completed_cleanly':json.loads((out/(name+'.supervisor.json')).read_bytes()).get('completed_cleanly')}


def expect(r):
    n, tr = r['case'], str(r['trip_reason'])
    if n == 'A': return r['completed_cleanly'] is False and r['leader_returncode'] is None and r['trip_reason'] is None and r['poll_calls'] == 1 and r['reaped_by_control_or_record_returncode'] == 0
    if n == 'B': return (r['completed_cleanly'] is True and r['leader_returncode'] == 0 and r['trip_reason'] is None and r['injected_calls'] == 1
                         and r['poll_calls'] >= 2 and r['first_real_offset_s'] is not None and r['last_returned'] == 0 and not r['stop_ran'])
    if n == 'C': return (r['completed_cleanly'] is False and r['leader_returncode'] is None and r['trip_reason'] is None and r['injected_calls'] == r['poll_calls'] >= 2
                         and 4.95 <= r['poll_span_s'] <= 5.002 and not r['stop_ran'] and r['reaped_by_control_or_record_returncode'] == 0)
    if n == 'D': return r['completed_cleanly'] is False and r['leader_returncode'] == 3 and r['trip_reason'] is None and r['last_returned'] == 3
    if n == 'E': return r['completed_cleanly'] is True and r['leader_returncode'] == 0 and r['trip_reason'] is None and r['injected_calls'] == 0
    if n in ('G','H'): return (r['completed_cleanly'] is False and tr.startswith('wall cap') and 'delayed reap' not in tr and r['poll_calls'] == 1
                               and r['stop_ran'] and not r['uncertain'] and r['quarantine_record'] is None and r['reaped_by_control_or_record_returncode'] == -15)
    if n == 'I': return (r['completed_cleanly'] is False and tr == 'external SIGTERM during delayed reap' and r['stop_ran'] and r['observed_signal'] == 'SIGTERM'
                         and r['quarantine_record'] is None and r['reaped_by_control_or_record_returncode'] == 0)
    if n == 'J': return r['completed_cleanly'] is False and tr.startswith('wall cap') and tr.endswith('during delayed reap') and r['stop_ran'] and r['reaped_by_control_or_record_returncode'] == 0
    if n == 'K': return r['completed_cleanly'] is False and tr.startswith('free bytes 0 below floor') and tr.endswith('during delayed reap') and r['stop_ran']
    if n == 'L': return r['completed_cleanly'] is False and tr.startswith('aggregate RSS') and tr.endswith('during delayed reap') and r['stop_ran']
    if n == 'M': return r['completed_cleanly'] is False and r['trip_reason'] is not None and r['uncertain'] is True and r['quarantine_record'] is not None and r['stop_ran']
    if n == 'N': return (r['completed_cleanly'] is False and tr == 'external SIGTERM before the completion record' and not r['stop_ran']
                         and r['leader_returncode'] == 0 and r['observed_signal'] == 'SIGTERM' and r['written_equals_returned'])
    if n == 'P5': return (r['written_completed_cleanly'] is True and r['written_observed_signal'] is None and r['observed_signal'] == 'SIGTERM'
                          and not r['written_equals_returned'] and r['outer_handler_calls'] == 0)  # the reviewed v5 defect, reproduced
    if n == 'P6': return (r['written_equals_returned'] and r['written_completed_cleanly'] is True and r['written_observed_signal'] is None
                          and r['observed_signal'] is None and r['outer_handler_calls'] == 1)
    raise KeyError(n)


def main(v6sha):
    out = L/'cycle2'/('supervise-v6-control-%s' % time.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%S')); out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
    started = time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z')
    shas = {'v3':PINS['v3'][1],'v5':PINS['v5'][1],'v6':v6sha}
    mods = {k:load(k,shas[k]) for k in shas}
    ok, sleep30 = 'pass', 'import time; time.sleep(30)'
    plan = [('A','v3',ok,{'inject':1},60.0,{}),('B','v6',ok,{'inject':1},60.0,{}),('C','v6',ok,{'inject':10**9},60.0,{}),
            ('D','v6','import sys; sys.exit(3)',{'inject':1},60.0,{}),('E','v6',ok,{},60.0,{}),
            ('G','v6',sleep30,{'inject':1},1.0,{}),('H','v3',sleep30,{'inject':1},1.0,{}),
            ('I','v6',ok,{'inject':3,'signal_at_call':2},60.0,{}),('J','v6',ok,{'inject':10**9},1.0,{}),
            ('K','v6',ok,{'inject':1},60.0,{'floor_shim':True}),('L','v6',ok,{'inject':1},60.0,{'probe_mode':'rss'}),
            ('M','v6',ok,{'inject':1},60.0,{'probe_mode':'unknown','grace':2.0}),('N','v6',ok,{'inject':1,'signal_on_reap':True},60.0,{}),
            ('P5','v5',ok,{},60.0,{'record_open_signal':True}),('P6','v6',ok,{},60.0,{'record_open_signal':True})]
    rows = []
    for name,label,code,pl,wall,kw in plan:
        r = run_case(out,name,mods[label],label,shas[label],code,pl,wall,**kw); r['expected_ok'] = expect(r); rows.append(r)
        print(json.dumps({k:r[k] for k in ('case','module','completed_cleanly','leader_returncode','trip_reason','stop_ran','poll_calls','poll_span_s','expected_ok')}),flush=True)
    receipt = {'schema':'PA19-SUPERVISE-V6-CONTROL-v1','started_host_clock':started,'finished_host_clock':time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z'),
        'control_source_sha256':digest(__file__),'pins':{k:{'path':PINS[k][0],'sha256':shas[k]} for k in shas},'python':sys.version.split()[0],
        'cases':rows,'all_expected':all(r['expected_ok'] for r in rows),'production_coverage':False,
        'scope':'injected events reproduce record signatures and delayed-reap trips; the live kernel race itself is not reproduced'}
    with (out/'receipt.json').open('x') as f: json.dump(receipt,f,indent=1); f.write('\n')
    print(out/'receipt.json',digest(out/'receipt.json'),'all_expected',receipt['all_expected'],flush=True)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    R6.install_handlers()
    with R6.Capacity(time.monotonic()+3600,metadata=True,wait_allowance=60):
        s = os.statvfs(L); assert s.f_bavail*s.f_frsize >= R6.BASE_GATE+16*1024**2
        main(sys.argv[1])

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""V3: one attempt, contract-authoritative binaries, retained Popen reaping, safety-first UNKNOWN/integrity veto.
v6_3: a supervisor-observed signal or an owner cancellation at any point up to outcome composition makes the item
UNKNOWN with a persistent HALT (never qualified).
No automatic RSS retry. A safety trip always dominates a worker's bounded-UNKNOWN/proof-cap report. Every veto is
persistent before token release; group quiescence AND explicit owned-leader wait are prerequisites for release.
"""
import hashlib
import json
import os
import time
from pathlib import Path

import m2_ms09_contract_v6_3 as C
import m2_supervised_runtime_v6_3 as R
import m2_supervised_evidence_v6_3 as EVIDENCE

L = C.LANE
WORKER = L/'src/m2_native_staged_v6_3.py'


class BindingRefusal(Exception):
    """v6_3: the constructor's bound-input check failed BEFORE any pin/job/group; an unattempted refusal, never a veto."""


def bounded_publish(path,value,stage,limit):
    raw = (json.dumps(value,indent=1)+'\n').encode()
    if len(raw) > limit: raise ValueError('frozen metadata publication bound exceeded')
    C.publish_bytes(path,raw,stage)
    return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()


def persist_veto(result,paths,contract_sha,recipe):
    if result.get('sat_candidate'):
        kind = 'SAT'
    elif result.get('integrity_status') == 'INVALID':
        kind = 'INTEGRITY'
    elif result.get('halt_production'):
        kind = 'HALT'
    else: return
    flag = L/'cycle2'/('m2k3-'+kind+'.flag')
    note = {'status':'UNKNOWN','veto':kind,'host_clock':time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z'),
        'production_contract_sha256':contract_sha,'recipe':recipe,'owner_pid':os.getpid(),
        'worker_result':str(Path(paths['worker_result']).relative_to(L)),
        'supervisor_record':str(Path(paths['supervisor']).relative_to(L)),
        'integrity_errors':result.get('integrity_errors'),'safety_veto':result.get('safety_veto'),
        'scope':'persistent unverified SAT / integrity / safety hold; scientific result UNKNOWN'}
    while not flag.exists():
        try:
            with flag.open('x') as f: json.dump(note,f,indent=1)
            return
        except FileExistsError: return
        except OSError: time.sleep(0.25)  # token stays owned throughout this receipt-only wait


def supervisor_safety_errors(rec,settlement):
    errors = []
    if rec.get('completed_cleanly') is not True: errors.append('supervisor did not complete cleanly')
    for key in ('trip_reason','uncertain','exception','quarantine_record','quarantine_write_error','cleanup_exception','record_write_error','stop_error'):
        if rec.get(key): errors.append(key+': '+str(rec[key]))
    stop = rec.get('stop') or {}
    if stop: errors.append('supervisor performed safety-stop cleanup')
    if stop.get('killpg_error'): errors.append('killpg_error: '+str(stop['killpg_error']))
    if not isinstance(settlement,dict) or settlement.get('group_quiescent') is not True or settlement.get('leader_reaped') is not True or settlement.get('explicit_owned_popen_wait') is not True:
        errors.append('group quiescence/explicit owned leader reaping not affirmed')
    return errors


def apply_worker_outcome(result,native,rec,settlement):
    """Shared actual production/control composition; a worker bounded-UNKNOWN can NEVER clear a safety hold."""
    safety = supervisor_safety_errors(rec,settlement)
    if safety:
        result.update(status='UNKNOWN',checked=False,halt_production=True,safety_veto=safety)
    elif native is not None:
        if native['status'] == 'UNSAT' and native['integrity_status'] == 'VALIDATED' and not native.get('sat_candidate') and not native.get('halt_production'):
            result.update(status='UNSAT',checked=True,halt_production=False)
        else:
            result.update(status='UNKNOWN',checked=False,halt_production=bool(native.get('halt_production') or result.get('sat_candidate') or native['integrity_status'] == 'INVALID'))
    result['chunk_stop'] = bool(result.get('halt_production') or (native or {}).get('chunk_stop'))
    return result


def execute(constructor,recipe,contract_sha,source_sha,paths,deadline,admission,solver='kissat',seconds=600):
    """All expectations derive from the frozen contract admission object; observed hashes NEVER become authority."""
    authority = admission['binary_authority']
    assert authority['solver']['path'] == '/opt/homebrew/bin/'+solver
    result = {'pipeline_schema':'PA19-SUPERVISED-DRAT-v6_3','status':'UNKNOWN','checked':False,
        'integrity_status':'NOT_EVALUATED','integrity_errors':[],'sat_candidate':False,'halt_production':False,
        'group_started':False,'production_contract_sha256':contract_sha,'multiset':recipe['multiset'],'b_index':recipe['b_index'],
        'indices':recipe.get('indices'),'encoder':'encode_skel_b.build_v2' if recipe['mode'] == 'direct' else 'encode_skel_b.build_partbatch',
        'recipe':recipe,'proof_retained':False,'cnf_retained':False,'solver_name':solver,'native_limit_seconds':seconds,
        'checker_limit_seconds':1200,'binary_authority':authority,'automatic_retry_allowed':False}
    stage = Path(paths['staging'])
    with R.Capacity(deadline) as capacity:
        try:
            now = time.monotonic()
            lease = {'owner_pid':os.getpid(),'projected_growth_bytes':R.ITEM_GROWTH,
                'census_reference':admission['census_reference'],'whole_plan_remaining_bound_bytes':admission['whole_plan_remaining_bound_bytes'],
                'force_census_refresh':capacity.wait_seconds > R.CENSUS_TTL,'binary_authority':authority,
                'group_rss_cap_bytes':R.GROUP_RSS_CAP,'busy_units':2,'lane_busy_ceiling':4,
                'chunk_deadline_monotonic':deadline,'item_deadline_monotonic':now+2400,
                'admission_cutoff_epoch':admission.get('admission_cutoff_epoch')}
            pre = R.full_gate(lease,'construct')
            result['owner_preconstruction_gate'] = pre
            if not pre['admitted']:
                # refusal rule1: before any pin/job; unattempted, no record and no persistent HALT.
                result.update(resource_refusal=pre['errors'],unattempted='before-pin',halt_production=False,chunk_stop=True)
                return result
            try:
                raw = constructor()
            except BindingRefusal as exc:
                # v6_3: explicit pre-pin binding refusal; no pin/job/group exists; unattempted, chunk ends, no veto.
                result.update(binding_refusal=str(exc),unattempted='before-pin',halt_production=False,chunk_stop=True)
                return result
            h,nbytes = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),len(raw)
            result.update(cnf_sha256=h,cnf_bytes=nbytes)
            pin = {'schema':'PA19-K1-CNF-PIN-v6_3','host_clock':time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z'),
                'production_contract_sha256':contract_sha,'multiset':recipe['multiset'],'b_index':recipe['b_index'],
                'indices':recipe.get('indices'),'cnf_sha256':h,'cnf_bytes':nbytes,'recipe':recipe,'source_sha256':source_sha,
                'supervisor_sha256':R.SUP_SHA,'binary_authority':authority,'no_cnf_or_proof_retained':True}
            pin_sha = bounded_publish(paths['pin'],pin,stage,16384)
            result.update(pre_child_pin_sha256=pin_sha,pre_child_pin_path=str(Path(paths['pin']).relative_to(L)))
            lease['item_deadline_monotonic'] = time.monotonic()+2400
            job = {'schema':'PA19-NATIVE-JOB-v6_3','recipe':recipe,'cnf_sha256':h,'cnf_bytes':nbytes,'solver':solver,
                'solver_seconds':seconds,'checker_seconds':1200,'lease':lease,'source_sha256':source_sha,'binary_authority':authority,
                'workdir':str(paths['workdir']),'result_path':str(paths['worker_result'])}
            job_sha = bounded_publish(paths['job'],job,stage,16384)
            del raw
            command = [authority['python']['path'],'-B',str(WORKER),str(paths['job']),job_sha]
            rec,gate = capacity.supervise(command,'PA19-'+paths['id'],lease,paths['supervisor'],paths['quarantine'])
            result['owner_prespawn_gate'] = gate
            if rec is None:

    if r.get('encoder') != ex['encoder']: errors.append('wrong independent encoder')
    if type(r.get('cnf_bytes')) is not int or r['cnf_bytes'] != ex['cnf_bytes'] or r.get('cnf_sha256') != ex['cnf_sha256']: errors.append('wrong exact CNF bytes/SHA')

    """EXACT original run_m2_15 constructor/arguments; no M1 encoder/clauses or new symmetry."""
    sp = LANE/c['skeleton_path']

    special = [p for p in D['profiles'] if list(p) != P0]
    if indices is None:
        nv,cl = ENC.build_v2(D['c0'],[tuple(t) for t in sk['types']],sk['empty'],special)
    else:
        ls = ca['list']
        raw = (LANE/ls['path']).read_bytes()
        assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == ls['sha256']

        assert data['num_placements'] == len(data['placements']) == ls['n'] > 0

    for name in supervised_runtime.PERSISTENT_VETO_FLAGS:
        flag = LANE/'cycle2'/name
        if flag.exists():
            paths.add(flag)
    sats,invalid = [],[]
    for p in sorted(paths):
        try:
            r = read(p)
        except (OSError,ValueError,UnicodeError) as exc:
            invalid.append({'path':str(p.relative_to(LANE)),'error':repr(exc)})
            continue
        if not isinstance(r,dict):
            invalid.append({'path':str(p.relative_to(LANE)),'error':'scientific JSON is not an object'})

            continue
        inner = r.get('native_result') if isinstance(r.get('native_result'),dict) else {}
        checker = inner.get('checker_collector') if isinstance(inner.get('checker_collector'),dict) else {}
        if r.get('status') == 'SAT' or inner.get('status') == 'SAT' or r.get('sat_candidate') is True or inner.get('sat_candidate') is True or p.name in supervised_runtime.SAT_VETO_FLAGS:
            sats.append({'path':str(p.relative_to(LANE)),'sha256':E.digest(p)})
        if r.get('integrity_status') == 'INVALID' or inner.get('integrity_status') == 'INVALID' or r.get('status') == 'INVALID' or inner.get('status') == 'INVALID' or any('NOT VERIFIED' in str(v) for v in checker.get('status_lines',[])) or p.name in supervised_runtime.NONSAT_VETO_FLAGS:
            invalid.append({'path':str(p.relative_to(LANE)),'error':'persistent INVALID/safety veto','sha256':E.digest(p)})

def inspect_new(c,contract_sha,ca,it,verify_formula=False):
    p = LANE/it['new_record']
    if not p.exists():
        return {'state':'MISSING','errors':[],'sat':False}
    try:
        pin,commit = read(LANE/it['pin']),read(LANE/it['commit'])
        assert pin['schema'] == 'PA19-K1-CNF-PIN-v6_3' and commit['schema'] == 'PA19-K1-RECEIPT-v6_3'
        assert pin['production_contract_sha256'] == commit['production_contract_sha256'] == contract_sha
        assert type(pin['multiset']) is int and pin['multiset'] == 9
        assert type(pin['b_index']) is int and type(commit['b_index']) is int
        assert pin['b_index'] == commit['b_index'] == ca['b_index']
        idx = it['indices']
        assert pin['indices'] == commit['indices'] == idx
        val = next((x for x in c['validation_tasks'] if x['id'] == it['id']),None)
        if val:
            assert pin['cnf_sha256'] == val['expected']['cnf_sha256'] and pin['cnf_bytes'] == val['expected']['cnf_bytes']
        if idx is not None:
            assert isinstance(pin['indices'],list) and all(type(v) is int for v in pin['indices']+commit['indices'])
        recipe = pin['recipe']
        assert recipe['multiset'] == 9 and recipe['b_index'] == ca['b_index'] and recipe['indices'] == idx
        assert recipe['mode'] == ('direct' if idx is None else 'partbatch')
        if idx is not None:
            assert recipe['list_path'] == ca['list']['path'] and recipe['list_sha256'] == ca['list']['sha256'] and recipe['complete_denominator'] == ca['list']['n']
        assert recipe['skeleton_path'] == c['skeleton_path'] and recipe['skeleton_sha256'] == c['skeleton_sha256']
        assert recipe['encoder_sha256'] == c['source_sha256']['src/encode_skel_b.py']
        assert pin['source_sha256'] == c['source_sha256'] and pin['supervisor_sha256'] == c['supervisor']['sha256']
        assert pin['binary_authority'] == c['binary_authority']
        assert commit['pin_sha256'] == E.digest(LANE/it['pin']) and commit['record_sha256'] == E.digest(p)
        ctx = context(ca['b_index'],idx,pin['cnf_sha256'],pin['cnf_bytes'],True)
        ctx.update(lane_root=str(LANE),binary_authority=c['binary_authority'],source_sha256=c['source_sha256'],recipe=recipe)
        if verify_formula:
            raw = formula(c,ca,idx)
            assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == pin['cnf_sha256'] and len(raw) == pin['cnf_bytes']
        r = E.inspect(p,ctx,commit['record_sha256'])
        obj = r.get('record') or {}
        assert isinstance(obj,dict)
        assert obj.get('production_contract_sha256') == contract_sha and obj.get('pre_child_pin_sha256') == commit['pin_sha256']
        assert obj.get('count_for_scientific_coverage') is True and obj.get('runner') == 'run_m2_ms09_k1_v6_3.py'
        assert obj.get('pipeline_schema') == 'PA19-SUPERVISED-DRAT-v6_3'
        if idx is not None:
            assert obj.get('list_sha256') == ca['list']['sha256'] and obj.get('enumerator') == 'extend_b.py'
            assert type(obj.get('complete_denominator')) is int and obj['complete_denominator'] == ca['list']['n']
        return r
    except (OSError,ValueError,KeyError,AssertionError,TypeError) as exc:
        return {'state':'INTEGRITY_VETO','errors':['new record/pin/commit binding failed: '+repr(exc)],'sat':False}






def inventory(c,contract_sha,verify_formulas=False):
    """Final coverage consumes ONLY complete measured-v3 inputs; historical outcomes remain separately visible."""
    verify_sources(c)
    sats,issues = sat_scan()
    rows,covered_indices,open_indices,original_only = [],0,0,[]
    for ca in c['cases']:
        bi = ca['b_index']
        if ca.get('direct'):
            dr = ca['direct']
            historical = E.inspect(LANE/dr['path'],dr['expected'],dr['sha256'])
            if historical['state'] != 'QUALIFIED': issues.append({'case':bi,'historical_direct':historical['errors']})
            task = ca['direct_task']
            chk = inspect_new(c,contract_sha,ca,task,verify_formulas)
            done = chk['state'] == 'QUALIFIED'
            if chk['state'] in ('INTEGRITY_VETO','HALT_UNKNOWN','SAT_VETO'): issues.append({'case':bi,'new_direct':chk['errors']})
            if not done and historical['state'] == 'QUALIFIED': original_only.append(task['id'])
            rows.append({'b_index':bi,'state':'DIRECT_CHECKED' if done else 'OPEN','solver_checked':done,
                         'historical_class':'ORIGINAL-QUALIFIED, exact checker input delivery NOT_RETAINED',
                         'validation':chk['state']})
            continue
        if ca['list']['n'] == 0:
            proof = structural_acceptance(c,ca)
            rows.append({'b_index':bi,'state':'STRUCTURAL_PARENT_MATH' if proof.get('accepted') else 'OPEN_EMPTY_NO_VACUOUS_ACCEPTANCE',
                         'solver_checked':False,'structural':proof})
            continue
        states = []
        for it in ca['intervals']:
            ident = it['id']
            historical_state = None
            if it.get('baseline'):
                ref = it['baseline']
                old = E.inspect(LANE/ref['path'],ref['expected'],ref['sha256'])
                historical_state = 'ORIGINAL-QUALIFIED' if old['state'] == 'QUALIFIED' else 'INVALID'
                if historical_state == 'INVALID': issues.append({'interval':ident,'historical':old['errors']})
            if ident in c['reserved_ids']:
                historical_state = 'CALIBRATION_ORIGINAL_COUNT_FALSE'
            chk = inspect_new(c,contract_sha,ca,it,verify_formulas)
            state = 'COVERED' if chk['state'] == 'QUALIFIED' else chk['state']
            if state in ('INTEGRITY_VETO','HALT_UNKNOWN','SAT_VETO'): issues.append({'interval':ident,'new':chk['errors']})
            if historical_state and state != 'COVERED': original_only.append(ident)
            size = it['indices'][1]-it['indices'][0]+1
            if state == 'COVERED': covered_indices += size
            else: open_indices += size
            states.append({'id':ident,'indices':it['indices'],'state':state,'historical_class':historical_state})
        done = bool(states) and all(s['state'] == 'COVERED' for s in states)
        rows.append({'b_index':bi,'state':'FULL_INTERVAL_UNION_CHECKED' if done else 'OPEN','solver_checked':done,
                     'denominator':ca['list']['n'],'intervals':states})
    resolved = sum(r['state'] in ('DIRECT_CHECKED','FULL_INTERVAL_UNION_CHECKED','STRUCTURAL_PARENT_MATH') for r in rows)
    for row in rows:
        row['closed_for_final'] = bool(verify_formulas and not sats and not issues and row['state'] in
                                      ('DIRECT_CHECKED','FULL_INTERVAL_UNION_CHECKED','STRUCTURAL_PARENT_MATH'))
    return {'scope':'ms09 component ONLY; not a global PA19/M1/other-multiset verdict','rows':rows,'cases':71,
            'progress_receipt_resolved_cases':resolved,'closed_cases_for_final':sum(r['closed_for_final'] for r in rows),
            'progress_solver_receipt_cases':sum(r['solver_checked'] for r in rows),
            'structural_parent_math_cases':sum(r['state'] == 'STRUCTURAL_PARENT_MATH' for r in rows),
            'covered_placement_indices':covered_indices,'open_placement_indices':open_indices,'sat_veto':sats,'integrity_issues':issues,
            'formula_verification_mode':verify_formulas,'final_ms09_acceptance_ready':bool(verify_formulas and resolved == 71 and not sats and not issues),
            'historical_inputs_pending_measured_validation':sorted(set(original_only)),
            'historical_outcomes_never_final_counted':True,'parent_calibration_reuse_permission':'WITHDRAWN',
            'admission_union':supervised_runtime.admission_union(LANE)}

"""Frozen complete independent-B ms09 cover through measured v3. Parent source PASS/GO before native controls/run.
One attempt/input, no automatic retry. All supervisor stops remain UNKNOWN plus persistent safety hold. Primary
ascending complete-list size/index queue precedes14 explicitly released exact-input validations. Old outcomes stay.

import datetime
import hashlib
import json

import m2_ms09_contract_v6_3 as C
import m2_ms09_evidence_v6_3 as E
import m2_supervised_runtime_v6_3 as R

L = C.LANE


def claim(path,contract_sha,ident):
    p = L/path; p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    try: fd = os.open(p,os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL|os.O_WRONLY,0o644)
    except FileExistsError: return False
    try: os.write(fd,('%d %s %s %s\n' % (os.getpid(),time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z'),contract_sha,ident)).encode())
    finally: os.close(fd)
    return True


def release_unattempted(path,reason):
    src = L/path; dst = L/'archive/k1-v6_3-unattempted'/('%s.%d' % (src.name,time.time_ns()))
    dst.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True); assert not dst.exists()
    h = E.digest(src); os.rename(src,dst)
    with (L/'archive/MANIFEST.tsv').open('a') as f:
        f.write('%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' % (time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z'),path,str(dst.relative_to(L)),h,reason))


def retire_unattempted_after_pin(it,paths,reason):
    """refusal rule2: own pin/job/claim only, after proving no worker/supervisor/quarantine artifact exists."""
    for key in ('supervisor','worker_result','quarantine'):
        assert not Path(paths[key]).exists(), ('worker group evidence exists; not unattempted',key)
    assert not (L/it['new_record']).exists() and not (L/it['commit']).exists()
    for rel in (it['pin'],str(Path(paths['job']).relative_to(L)),it['claim']):
        if (L/rel).exists(): release_unattempted(rel,reason)


def item_paths(it,stage):
    base = L/it['new_record']
    return {'id':it['id'],'pin':L/it['pin'],'staging':stage,'job':Path(str(base)+'.job.json'),
        'supervisor':Path(str(base)+'.supervisor.json'),'quarantine':Path(str(base)+'.quarantine.json'),
        'worker_result':Path(str(base)+'.worker.json'),
        'workdir':L/'scratch/fifo'/('m2k1_v6_3_'+it['id'].replace(':','_').replace('-','_'))}


def publish_item(r,c,contract_sha,ca,it,stage):
    idx = it['indices']
    r.update(multiset=9,b_index=ca['b_index'],indices=idx,encoder='encode_skel_b.build_v2' if idx is None else 'encode_skel_b.build_partbatch',
             runner='run_m2_ms09_k1_v6_3.py',production_contract_sha256=contract_sha,count_for_scientific_coverage=True)
    if idx is not None: r.update(list_sha256=ca['list']['sha256'],complete_denominator=ca['list']['n'],enumerator='extend_b.py')
    if r.get('sat_candidate'): assert (L/'cycle2/m2k3-SAT.flag').exists()
    elif r.get('integrity_status') == 'INVALID': assert (L/'cycle2/m2k3-INTEGRITY.flag').exists()
    elif r.get('halt_production'): assert (L/'cycle2/m2k3-HALT.flag').exists() or (L/'cycle2/m2k3-QUARANTINE.flag').exists()
    raw = (json.dumps(r,indent=1)+'\n').encode(); assert len(raw) <= 16*1024**2
    rh = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
    C.publish_json(L/it['commit'],{'schema':'PA19-K1-RECEIPT-v6_3','production_contract_sha256':contract_sha,
        'b_index':ca['b_index'],'indices':idx,'record_sha256':rh,'pin_sha256':r.get('pre_child_pin_sha256'),
        'host_clock':time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z')},stage)
    C.publish_bytes(L/it['new_record'],raw,stage)  # primary LAST, immutable pin and commit already exist
    n = r.get('native_result') or {}
    return {'id':it['id'],'record':it['new_record'],'record_sha256':rh,'status':r['status'],'checked':r.get('checked') is True,
        'integrity_status':r.get('integrity_status'),'halt_production':r.get('halt_production'),
        'solve_seconds':n.get('solve_seconds'),'check_seconds':n.get('check_seconds'),'proof_bytes':n.get('proof_stream',{}).get('raw_bytes'),
        'cnf_sha256':r.get('cnf_sha256')}


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(); ap.add_argument('contract'); ap.add_argument('sha256')
    ap.add_argument('--max-attempts',type=int); ap.add_argument('--queue',choices=('open','validation'),default='open')
    ap.add_argument('--parent-priority-release')
    args = ap.parse_args()
    if args.max_attempts is not None: assert args.max_attempts > 0
    if args.queue == 'validation': assert args.parent_priority_release, 'explicit parent open-M2 priority release required'
    R.install_handlers()
    cutoff = datetime.datetime.fromisoformat('2026-10-18T18:31:43-07:00').timestamp()
    deadline = min(time.monotonic()+10800,time.monotonic()+max(0,cutoff-time.time()))
    runid = '%s-%d-%d' % (time.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%S'),os.getpid(),time.time_ns())
    stage,logs = L/'scratch/m2k1-v6_3-publish'/runid,L/'cycle2/m2k3-chunks'/runid
    logs.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
    init = {'stage':'capacity','veto_detail':None}
    try:
        with R.Capacity(deadline,metadata=True,wait_allowance=60):
            init['stage'] = 'load'
            c = C.load(args.contract,args.sha256)
            init['stage'] = 'binary'
            assert all(o['matches'] for o in R.binary_observations(c['binary_authority']).values()), 'contract binary drift'
            init['stage'] = 'inventory'
            initial = C.inventory(c,args.sha256)
            init['veto_detail'] = {'sat_veto':initial['sat_veto'],'integrity_issues':initial['integrity_issues'][:50],
                                   'veto_markers':R.present_vetoes(L),'admission_union':R.admission_union(L)}
            assert not initial['sat_veto'] and not initial['integrity_issues'], 'persistent SAT/integrity/safety veto'
            init['stage'] = 'resource-stop'
            assert not R.present_resource_stops(L), 'resource STOP present (distinct from persistent veto)'
            init['stage'] = 'queue'
            byid = {it['id']:(ca,it) for ca in c['cases'] for it in ca['intervals']}
            byid['b00001:direct'] = c['cases'][1],c['cases'][1]['direct_task']
            order = c['pending_order'] if args.queue == 'open' else c['validation_order']
            if args.queue == 'validation': assert all((L/byid[x][1]['new_record']).exists() for x in c['pending_order'])
            init['stage'] = 'census'  # exact census at chunk start; later admissions refresh at age/wait>600s
            reference = R.create_census()
            admission = {'binary_authority':c['binary_authority'],'census_reference':reference,
                         'whole_plan_remaining_bound_bytes':c['resource_policy']['whole_plan_remaining_bound_bytes']}
            live = R.census_for_gate(reference)
            assert live['current_data_upper_bytes']+admission['whole_plan_remaining_bound_bytes']+R.OTHER_WRITER_MARGIN <= R.DATA_CAP
            fresh = (lambda s:s.f_bavail*s.f_frsize)(os.statvfs(L))
            assert fresh >= R.BASE_GATE+R.ITEM_GROWTH
            init['stage'] = 'admission-receipt'
            C.publish_json(logs/'admission.json',{'host_clock':time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z'),'contract_sha256':args.sha256,
                'fresh_free_bytes':fresh,'admission':admission,'chunk_start_census':live,'queue':args.queue,
                'parent_priority_release':args.parent_priority_release,'deadline_monotonic':deadline,
                'accounting_residual':c['resource_policy']['residual']},stage)
    except BaseException as exc:
        C.publish_json(logs/'initialization-deferred.json',{'status':'UNKNOWN','reason':repr(exc),'init_stage':init['stage'],
            'veto_detail':init['veto_detail'],'native_has_started':False,'contract_sha256':args.sha256,
            'host_clock':time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z')},stage)
        print(logs,repr(exc),flush=True); return
    records,attempts,stop = [],0,None
    for ident in order:
        if args.max_attempts is not None and attempts >= args.max_attempts: stop = 'operational tranche reached'; break
        if R._CANCEL[0] or time.monotonic()+2550 > deadline: stop = 'deadline/cancellation; no new native'; break
        ca,it = byid[ident]
        if (L/it['new_record']).exists():
            q = C.inspect_new(c,args.sha256,ca,it)
            if q['state'] in ('INTEGRITY_VETO','SAT_VETO','HALT_UNKNOWN'): stop = 'existing persistent veto '+ident; break
            continue  # UNKNOWN is preserved, never automatically retried.
        if not claim(it['claim'],args.sha256,ident): continue
        recipe = {'mode':'direct' if it['indices'] is None else 'partbatch','multiset':9,'b_index':ca['b_index'],'indices':it['indices'],
            'skeleton_path':c['skeleton_path'],'skeleton_sha256':c['skeleton_sha256'],'encoder_sha256':c['source_sha256']['src/encode_skel_b.py']}
        if it['indices'] is not None: recipe.update(list_path=ca['list']['path'],list_sha256=ca['list']['sha256'],complete_denominator=ca['list']['n'])
        def build():
            assert E.digest(args.contract) == args.sha256
            for rel,h in c['source_sha256'].items(): assert E.digest(L/rel) == h, ('source changed after capacity wait',rel)
            assert not (L/it['new_record']).exists()
            raw = C.formula(c,ca,it['indices'])
            val = next((x for x in c['validation_tasks'] if x['id'] == ident),None)
            if val: assert len(raw) == val['expected']['cnf_bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == val['expected']['cnf_sha256']
            return raw
        paths = item_paths(it,stage)
        try: r = OWNER.execute(build,recipe,args.sha256,c['source_sha256'],paths,deadline,admission)
        except BaseException as exc:
            C.publish_json(logs/('owner-exception-'+ident.replace(':','_')+'.json'),{'status':'UNKNOWN','reason':repr(exc),'id':ident},stage)
            if not (L/it['pin']).exists(): release_unattempted(it['claim'],'owner refused before immutable pin/native')
            stop = 'owner admission/exception; no automatic retry'; break
        if r.get('unattempted') == 'before-pin' and not (L/it['pin']).exists():
            C.publish_json(logs/('unattempted-'+ident.replace(':','_')+'.json'),r,stage)
            release_unattempted(it['claim'],'refusal rule1: admission refused before pin/job; no record or HALT')
            stop = 'pre-pin admission refusal; item remains MISSING'; break
        if r.get('unattempted') == 'after-pin-before-worker':
            C.publish_json(logs/('unattempted-'+ident.replace(':','_')+'.json'),r,stage)
            retire_unattempted_after_pin(it,paths,'refusal rule2: refused after pin/job before any worker process; no record or HALT')
            stop = 'pre-worker admission refusal; item remains MISSING'; break
        if not r.get('pre_child_pin_sha256'):
            C.publish_json(logs/('deferred-'+ident.replace(':','_')+'.json'),r,stage)
            release_unattempted(it['claim'],'constructor/pin incomplete; no native group could start')
            stop = 'pre-pin deferred'; break
        attempts += 1
        item = publish_item(r,c,args.sha256,ca,it,stage); records.append(item); print(json.dumps(item),flush=True)
        newest = (r.get('owner_prespawn_gate') or {}).get('census')
        for gate in (r.get('native_result') or {}).get('gates') or []:
            if gate.get('census'): newest = gate['census']
        if newest: admission['census_reference'] = newest['reference']
        if r.get('sat_candidate') or r.get('integrity_status') == 'INVALID' or r.get('halt_production'):
            stop = 'persistent SAT/integrity/safety veto'; break
        if r.get('chunk_stop'):
            stop = 'worker admission refusal recorded UNKNOWN; chunk ends without persistent HALT'; break
    C.publish_json(logs/'summary.json',{'host_clock':time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z'),'production_contract_sha256':args.sha256,
        'queue':args.queue,'attempts':attempts,'records':records,'stop_reason':stop,'all_original_outcomes_unchanged':True,
        'automatic_retry_allowed':False,'no_global_PA19_verdict':True},stage)
    print(logs,flush=True)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

    except (OSError,ValueError,KeyError,TypeError,AssertionError) as exc:

def freeze_misses(c,h):
    dest = L/'cycle2/ms06-initial-v6_3-UNKNOWN-misses-ONCE.json'; assert not dest.exists()
    rows = []

        bi = x['b_index']

        else:
            q = inspect(c,h,bi)

            r,rel = q['record'],task(bi)['new_record']

            rows.append({'job':'6:%d' % bi,'b_index':bi,'record':rel,'record_sha256':E.digest(L/rel),
                'cnf_sha256':r['cnf_sha256'],'cnf_bytes':r['cnf_bytes'],'status':'UNKNOWN','already_enumerated':bi in (68,73)})
    out = {'schema':'PA19-MS06-UNKNOWN-SET-v6_3','host_clock':time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z'),'initial_contract_sha256':h,
        'source_sha256':c['source_sha256'],'skeleton_sha256':c['skeleton_sha256'],'jobs':rows,
        'scope':'exact accumulated initial-pass UNKNOWN set; NO helper admission/denominator supplied here',
        'requires_new_source_denominator_growth_review_before_any_helper':True}

def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(); ap.add_argument('contract',nargs='?'); ap.add_argument('sha256',nargs='?')
    ap.add_argument('--freeze',action='store_true'); ap.add_argument('--freeze-misses',action='store_true'); ap.add_argument('--max-attempts',type=int,default=8)
    args = ap.parse_args(); R.install_handlers()
    cutoff = datetime.datetime.fromisoformat('2026-10-18T18:31:43-07:00').timestamp()
    deadline = min(time.monotonic()+10800,time.monotonic()+max(0,cutoff-time.time()))
    with R.Capacity(deadline,metadata=True,wait_allowance=60):
        st = os.statvfs(L); assert st.f_bavail*st.f_frsize >= R.BASE_GATE+1024**2
        if args.freeze: freeze(); return
        assert args.contract and args.sha256 and E.digest(args.contract) == args.sha256
        c = COMMON.read(args.contract); verify(c)
        if args.freeze_misses: freeze_misses(c,args.sha256); return
        # Same shared persistent-veto registry as every gate/inventory, plus this adapter's own existing records.
        union = R.admission_union(L)
        vetoes,stops = union['persistent_vetoes'],union['resource_stops']
        record_vetoes = {}
        for x in c['rows']:
            if (L/task(x['b_index'])['new_record']).exists():
                state = inspect(c,args.sha256,x['b_index'])['state']
                if state in ('INTEGRITY_VETO','SAT_VETO','HALT_UNKNOWN'): record_vetoes[x['b_index']] = state
        if vetoes or record_vetoes or stops:
            logs = L/'cycle2/m2k3-chunks'/('ms06-%s-%d' % (time.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%S'),time.time_ns()))
            logs.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
            COMMON.publish_json(logs/'initialization-deferred.json',{'status':'UNKNOWN',
                'init_stage':'veto-scan' if (vetoes or record_vetoes) else 'resource-stop',
                'reason':'persistent veto or resource STOP present; no claim or native admission','veto_markers':vetoes,
                'resource_stops':stops,'admission_union':union,'record_vetoes':record_vetoes,
                'native_has_started':False,'contract_sha256':args.sha256,'host_clock':time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z')},
                L/'scratch/m2k1-v6_3-publish'/('ms06-veto-'+str(time.time_ns())))
            print('M6 initialization veto',vetoes,record_vetoes,flush=True)
            return
        assert args.max_attempts > 0 and all(v['matches'] for v in R.binary_observations(c['binary_authority']).values())
        reference = R.create_census(); census = R.census_for_gate(reference)
        assert census['current_data_upper_bytes']+R.ALL_PLANNED_RETAINED_BOUND+R.OTHER_WRITER_MARGIN <= R.DATA_CAP
        admission = {'binary_authority':c['binary_authority'],'census_reference':reference,
                     'whole_plan_remaining_bound_bytes':c['resource_policy']['whole_plan_remaining_bound_bytes']}
        D = COMMON.read(L/SK); special = [p for p in D['profiles'] if list(p) != COMMON.P0]
    stage = L/'scratch/m2k1-v6_3-publish'/('ms06-'+str(time.time_ns())); attempts = 0
    for bi in c['pending_order']:
        if attempts >= args.max_attempts or R._CANCEL[0] or time.monotonic()+2550 > deadline: return
        it = task(bi)
        if (L/it['new_record']).exists():
            q = inspect(c,args.sha256,bi)
            if q['state'] in ('INTEGRITY_VETO','SAT_VETO','HALT_UNKNOWN'): raise RuntimeError('persistent existing veto '+repr(q))
            continue  # every previous UNKNOWN remains, no direct retry
        if not TX.claim(it['claim'],args.sha256,it['id']): continue
        recipe = {'mode':'direct','multiset':6,'b_index':bi,'indices':None,'skeleton_path':SK,
                  'skeleton_sha256':c['skeleton_sha256'],'encoder_sha256':c['source_sha256']['src/encode_skel_b.py']}
        def build():
            verify(c)
            sk = D['skeletons'][bi]
            nv,cl = ENC.build_v2(D['c0'],[tuple(t) for t in sk['types']],sk['empty'],special)
            return ENC.cnf_bytes(nv,cl)
        paths = TX.item_paths(it,stage)
        r = OWNER.execute(build,recipe,args.sha256,c['source_sha256'],paths,deadline,admission,'cadical',300)
        if r.get('unattempted') == 'before-pin' and not (L/it['pin']).exists():
            TX.release_unattempted(it['claim'],'refusal rule1: direct refused before pin/job; no record or HALT'); return
        if r.get('unattempted') == 'after-pin-before-worker':
            TX.retire_unattempted_after_pin(it,paths,'refusal rule2: direct refused before worker; no record or HALT'); return
        if not r.get('pre_child_pin_sha256'):
            TX.release_unattempted(it['claim'],'v4 direct construction incomplete before immutable pin/native'); return
        r.update(runner='run_m2_ms06_direct_v6_3.py',count_for_scientific_coverage=True)
        raw = (json.dumps(r,indent=1)+'\n').encode(); rh = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
        COMMON.publish_json(L/it['commit'],{'schema':'PA19-K1-RECEIPT-v6_3','production_contract_sha256':args.sha256,
            'b_index':bi,'record_sha256':rh,'pin_sha256':r['pre_child_pin_sha256']},stage)
        COMMON.publish_bytes(L/it['new_record'],raw,stage)
        attempts += 1
        print(json.dumps({'job':'6:%d' % bi,'record':it['new_record'],'sha256':rh,'status':r['status'],
                          'checked':r['checked'],'integrity_status':r['integrity_status']}),flush=True)
        for gate in (r.get('native_result') or {}).get('gates') or []:
            if gate.get('census'): admission['census_reference'] = gate['census']['reference']
        if r.get('sat_candidate') or r.get('integrity_status') == 'INVALID' or r.get('halt_production') or r.get('chunk_stop'): return


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Historical-M2 (A2 ms01..ms08) measured re-solve over the v6_3 transport (parent Codex review v2 HOLD fixes, plus the
v6_2 re-review fixes: ONE shared predicate for all five admissions; any signal/cancellation never qualifies, and the
publication window is signal-blocked with a final cancellation check; exact covered/excluded universe).
Each item regenerates its ORIGINAL independent-B formula; a mismatch with the bound historical receipt CNF is an
explicit pre-pin BindingRefusal (no pin/job/group, unattempted, chunk ends, no veto). CaDiCaL at the original 300/600
limit, drat-trim 1200, the same exact measured predicate, one attempt, no automatic retry, ONE pipeline (singleton
lock). Frozen policy clocks: no admission at/after 17:20 PDT (independent of STOP-K1; the v6_3 gates also refuse every
later worker/solver/checker phase); the chunk deadline is the 17:57 native end minus a 120 s cleanup allowance and
the runtime refuses any group whose 2400 s budget does not fit before it.
Historical receipts are validated per revision (5, 9, 12, 14, 15) with explicit layouts, and stay ORIGINAL-QUALIFIED
only. The M2H reader accepts ONLY the exact measured v6_3 schema with every primary/pin/commit binding; there is no
historical fallback. Whole-plan retained bound = runtime plan bound + every M2H item at the ordinary per-item bound.
Parent source GO required before running.
"""
import argparse
import datetime
import fcntl
import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
import signal
import time

import encode_skel_b as ENC
import m2_item_owner_v6_3 as OWNER
import m2_ms09_contract_v6_3 as COMMON
import m2_ms09_evidence_v6_3 as E
import m2_supervised_runtime_v6_3 as R
import run_m2_ms09_k1_v6_3 as TX

L = COMMON.LANE
SCHEMA = 'PA19-M2H-A2-v6_3'
RUNNER = 'run_m2h_v6_3.py'
EXTRA_SOURCES = ('src/freeze_m2h_v6_3.py','src/run_m2h_v6_3.py','src/final_m2h_inventory_v6_3.py')
POLICY_CLOCKS = {'admission_cutoff':'2026-10-18T17:20:00-07:00','native_end':'2026-10-18T17:57:00-07:00','cleanup_allowance_seconds':120}
SINGLETON = 'cycle2/m2h-v6_3-singleton.lock'
SHA_RE = re.compile(r'[0-9a-f]{64}')
STAGED = r'^/opt/homebrew/bin/cadical -q -t (300|600) CNF PROOF; binary DRAT staged \(zstd-1 in memory\) then drat-trim -i -t 1200$'
STREAMED = r'^/opt/homebrew/bin/cadical -q -t (600) CNF PROOF; binary DRAT streamed to drat-trim -i -t %d$'
# Explicit historical layouts (mode, stream_check_revision) -> (solver-string pattern, required drat s_lines, replay required)
HISTORICAL = {('direct',5):(STREAMED % 1800,None,False),('direct',9):(STREAMED % 1800,['s VERIFIED'],False),
              ('partbatch',9):(STREAMED % 1200,['s VERIFIED'],False),('direct',12):(STAGED,['s VERIFIED'],True),
              ('direct',14):(STAGED,['s VERIFIED'],True),('partbatch',14):(STAGED,['s VERIFIED'],True),
              ('direct',15):(STAGED,['s VERIFIED'],True),('partbatch',15):(STAGED,['s VERIFIED'],True)}


REQUIRED_ADMISSIONS = (('owner_preconstruction_gate','construct'),('owner_prespawn_gate','worker'),
                       ('worker_preconstruction_gate','construct'),('worker_solver_gate','solver'),('worker_checker_gate','checker'))


def admission_records(r):
    native = r.get('native_result') if isinstance(r.get('native_result'),dict) else {}
    gates = native.get('gates') if isinstance(native.get('gates'),list) else []
    return ({'owner_preconstruction_gate':r.get('owner_preconstruction_gate'),'owner_prespawn_gate':r.get('owner_prespawn_gate'),
             'worker_preconstruction_gate':native.get('worker_preconstruction_gate'),
             'worker_solver_gate':gates[0] if len(gates) > 0 else None,'worker_checker_gate':gates[1] if len(gates) > 1 else None},len(gates))


def admission_errors(r,cut,require_all):
    """ONE shared predicate for the five admissions of an item: every present admission record carries its phase and the
    frozen cutoff; every admitted one is timestamped strictly before the cutoff; a qualifying UNSAT needs all five admitted."""
    errors = []
    by,n = admission_records(r)
    if n > 2: errors.append('unexpected worker phase gate count %d' % n)
    for name,phase in REQUIRED_ADMISSIONS:
        g = by[name]
        if g is None:
            if require_all: errors.append('required admission missing: '+name)
            continue
        if not isinstance(g,dict): errors.append('admission record invalid: '+name); continue
        if g.get('phase') != phase: errors.append('admission phase differs: '+name)
        if g.get('admission_cutoff_epoch') != cut: errors.append('admission cutoff differs: '+name)
        if g.get('admitted') is True:
            if type(g.get('at_epoch')) not in (int,float) or not g['at_epoch'] < cut: errors.append('admission at/after the frozen cutoff or untimed: '+name)
        elif require_all: errors.append('required admission not admitted: '+name)
    return errors


def epochs(c=None):
    pc = POLICY_CLOCKS if c is None else c['policy_clocks']
    return (datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(pc['admission_cutoff']).timestamp(),datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(pc['native_end']).timestamp(),
            pc['cleanup_allowance_seconds'])


def resource_policy(n_items):
    p = COMMON.resource_policy()
    p['whole_plan_remaining_bound_bytes'] = R.ALL_PLANNED_RETAINED_BOUND+n_items*R.ITEM_ORDINARY_BOUND
    p['m2h_items_added_at_ordinary_bound'] = n_items
    return p


def historical_errors(x,r):
    """Identity of one historical checked-UNSAT receipt against its contract item; per-revision explicit layout."""
    errors, rev = [], r.get('stream_check_revision')
    layout = HISTORICAL.get((x['mode'],rev)) if type(rev) is int else None
    if layout is None: return ['unsupported historical layout %r' % ((x['mode'],rev),)]
    pattern,lines,replay = layout
    m = re.fullmatch(pattern,str(r.get('solver')))
    if not m or int(m.group(1)) != x['native_seconds']: errors.append('historical solver/limit layout differs')
    if rev != x['historical']['revision']: errors.append('historical revision differs')
    if r.get('status') != 'UNSAT' or r.get('checked') is not True or r.get('solver_rc') != 20 or r.get('drat_trim_verified') is not True: errors.append('not historical checked UNSAT')
    dt = r.get('drat_trim') if isinstance(r.get('drat_trim'),dict) else {}
    if dt.get('rc') != 0 or dt.get('stop') != 'self' or dt.get('says_verified') is not True or dt.get('s_lines') != lines: errors.append('historical checker verdict layout differs')
    if replay and not (isinstance(r.get('replay'),dict) and r['replay'].get('ok') is True): errors.append('historical replay missing')
    if type(r.get('multiset')) is not int or r['multiset'] != x['multiset'] or type(r.get('b_index')) is not int or r['b_index'] != x['b_index']: errors.append('historical case identity differs')
    if x['mode'] == 'direct':
        if r.get('indices') is not None or r.get('encoder') != 'encode_skel_b.build_v2': errors.append('historical direct identity differs')
    elif not (isinstance(r.get('indices'),list) and len(r['indices']) == 2 and all(type(v) is int for v in r['indices'])
              and r['indices'] == x['indices'] and r.get('encoder') == 'encode_skel_b.build_partbatch'): errors.append('historical exact interval/encoder differs')
    if not (isinstance(r.get('cnf_sha256'),str) and SHA_RE.fullmatch(r['cnf_sha256']) and r['cnf_sha256'] == x['expected_cnf_sha256']): errors.append('historical CNF SHA differs')
    if not (type(r.get('cnf_bytes')) is int and r['cnf_bytes'] > 0 and r['cnf_bytes'] == x['expected_cnf_bytes']): errors.append('historical CNF bytes differ')
    return errors


def list_errors(x,ed):
    errors = []
    src, rel = ed.get('source'), 'cycle2/skel-b/skeletons-b-ms%02d.json' % x['multiset']
    if not isinstance(src,str) or os.path.realpath(src) != os.path.realpath(L/rel) or type(ed.get('index')) is not int or ed['index'] != x['b_index']:
        errors.append('list source/index differs')
    n = ed.get('num_placements')
    if not (type(n) is int and n > 0 and isinstance(ed.get('placements'),list) and n == len(ed['placements']) == x['list']['n']): errors.append('list denominator differs')
    return errors


def task(item):
    if item['mode'] == 'direct':
        base = 'cycle2/m2skel_drat/ms%02d_b%05d_h6_3' % (item['multiset'],item['b_index'])
        claim = 'cycle2/claims/m2h6_3_ms%02d_b%05d.claim' % (item['multiset'],item['b_index'])
    else:
        lo,hi = item['indices']
        base = 'cycle2/m2part_drat/ms%02d_b%05d/batch_%05d_%05d_h6_3' % (item['multiset'],item['b_index'],lo,hi)
        claim = 'cycle2/claims/m2h6_3_ms%02d_b%05d_%05d_%05d.claim' % (item['multiset'],item['b_index'],lo,hi)
    return {'id':item['id'],'indices':item['indices'],'new_record':base+'.json','pin':base+'.cnf-pin.json',
            'commit':base+'.receipt.json','claim':claim}


def verify_sources(c):
    assert c['schema'] == SCHEMA and set(c['source_sha256']) == set(tuple(COMMON.SOURCE_FILES)+EXTRA_SOURCES)
    for p,h in c['source_sha256'].items(): assert E.digest(L/p) == h, ('frozen source changed',p)
    assert c['supervisor'] == {'path':str(R.SUP_PATH),'sha256':R.SUP_SHA} and E.digest(R.SUP_PATH) == R.SUP_SHA


def verify(c):
    verify_sources(c)
    assert c['policy_clocks'] == POLICY_CLOCKS
    assert c['resource_policy'] == resource_policy(len(c['items'])) and c['automatic_retry_allowed'] is False and c['check_seconds'] == 1200
    assert c['binary_authority']['solver']['path'] == '/opt/homebrew/bin/cadical'
    assert c['binary_authority']['checker']['path'] == str(L/'tools/drat-trim/drat-trim')
    assert sorted(c['skeletons']) == [str(m) for m in range(1,9)]
    totals = {}
    for mi,s in c['skeletons'].items():
        assert s['path'] == 'cycle2/skel-b/skeletons-b-ms%02d.json' % int(mi) and E.digest(L/s['path']) == s['sha256']
        totals[int(mi)] = len(COMMON.read(L/s['path'])['skeletons'])
    ids = [x['id'] for x in c['items']]
    assert c['order'] == ids and len(set(ids)) == len(ids)
    direct = [(x['multiset'],x['b_index']) for x in c['items'] if x['mode'] == 'direct']
    split = {(x['multiset'],x['b_index']) for x in c['items'] if x['mode'] == 'partbatch'}
    assert len(set(direct)) == len(direct) and not (set(direct) & split)
    lists = {}
    for x in c['items']:
        assert x['solver'] == 'cadical' and x['native_seconds'] in (300,600) and type(x['multiset']) is int and 1 <= x['multiset'] <= 8
        assert type(x['b_index']) is int and 0 <= x['b_index'] < totals[x['multiset']]
        exp_id = 'ms%02d_b%05d' % (x['multiset'],x['b_index']) if x['mode'] == 'direct' else 'ms%02d_b%05d:%05d-%05d' % (x['multiset'],x['b_index'],*x['indices'])
        assert x['id'] == exp_id and SHA_RE.fullmatch(x['expected_cnf_sha256']) and type(x['expected_cnf_bytes']) is int and x['expected_cnf_bytes'] > 0
        assert E.digest(L/x['historical']['path']) == x['historical']['sha256'], ('historical receipt changed',x['id'])
        errs = historical_errors(x,COMMON.read(L/x['historical']['path']))
        assert not errs, (x['id'],errs)
        if x['mode'] == 'partbatch':
            assert x['historical']['path'].startswith('cycle2/m2part_drat/ms%02d_b%05d/' % (x['multiset'],x['b_index']))
            lists.setdefault(x['list']['path'],(x['list']['sha256'],x['list']['n'],(x['multiset'],x['b_index'])))
            assert lists[x['list']['path']] == (x['list']['sha256'],x['list']['n'],(x['multiset'],x['b_index']))
            assert x['list']['path'] == 'cycle2/m2part_drat/ms%02d_b%05d/ext.json' % (x['multiset'],x['b_index'])
        else:
            assert x['mode'] == 'direct' and x['indices'] is None and x['historical']['path'] == 'cycle2/m2skel_drat/ms%02d_b%05d.json' % (x['multiset'],x['b_index'])
    for path,(h,n,case) in lists.items():
        assert E.digest(L/path) == h
        first = next(x for x in c['items'] if x['mode'] == 'partbatch' and x['list']['path'] == path)
        assert not list_errors(first,COMMON.read(L/path)), (path,list_errors(first,COMMON.read(L/path)))
        got = sorted(x['indices'] for x in c['items'] if x['mode'] == 'partbatch' and (x['multiset'],x['b_index']) == case)
        assert got == [[lo,min(n,lo+100)-1] for lo in range(0,n,100)], ('split item set is not the exact complete B100 partition',case)
    assert c['cases_direct'] == len(direct) and c['cases_split'] == len(split) and c['split_intervals'] == sum(x['mode'] == 'partbatch' for x in c['items'])
    excluded = [e['case'] for e in c['excluded_cases']]
    covered = {'ms%02d_b%05d' % k for k in set(direct) | split}
    universe = {'ms%02d_b%05d' % (mi,bi) for mi,n in totals.items() for bi in range(n)}
    assert len(set(excluded)) == len(excluded), 'duplicate excluded case'
    assert not (set(excluded) & covered), 'excluded case is also covered'
    assert set(excluded) | covered == universe, 'covered/excluded is not exactly the A2 ms01..ms08 skeleton universe'


def recipe(c,x):
    r = {'mode':x['mode'],'multiset':x['multiset'],'b_index':x['b_index'],'indices':x['indices'],
         'skeleton_path':c['skeletons'][str(x['multiset'])]['path'],'skeleton_sha256':c['skeletons'][str(x['multiset'])]['sha256'],
         'encoder_sha256':c['source_sha256']['src/encode_skel_b.py']}
    if x['mode'] == 'partbatch': r.update(list_path=x['list']['path'],list_sha256=x['list']['sha256'],complete_denominator=x['list']['n'])
    return r


def inspect(c,h,x):
    """EXACT measured v6_3 reader: every binding must hold; nothing historical can qualify here."""
    it = task(x)
    if not (L/it['new_record']).exists(): return {'state':'MISSING','record':None,'errors':[]}
    try:
        raw = (L/it['new_record']).read_bytes(); r = json.loads(raw)
        pin,k = COMMON.read(L/it['pin']),COMMON.read(L/it['commit'])
        assert pin['schema'] == 'PA19-K1-CNF-PIN-v6_3' and k['schema'] == 'PA19-K1-RECEIPT-v6_3'
        assert pin['production_contract_sha256'] == k['production_contract_sha256'] == h
        assert type(pin['multiset']) is int and pin['multiset'] == x['multiset'] and type(pin['b_index']) is int and pin['b_index'] == k['b_index'] == x['b_index']
        assert pin['indices'] == x['indices'] == k['indices'] and pin['recipe'] == recipe(c,x)
        assert pin['source_sha256'] == c['source_sha256'] and pin['binary_authority'] == c['binary_authority'] and pin['supervisor_sha256'] == R.SUP_SHA
        assert pin['cnf_sha256'] == x['expected_cnf_sha256'] and pin['cnf_bytes'] == x['expected_cnf_bytes']
        assert k['pin_sha256'] == E.digest(L/it['pin']) and k['record_sha256'] == hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
        assert isinstance(r,dict) and r.get('pipeline_schema') == 'PA19-SUPERVISED-DRAT-v6_3'
        assert r.get('production_contract_sha256') == h and r.get('pre_child_pin_sha256') == k['pin_sha256'] and r.get('pre_child_pin_path') == it['pin']
        assert r.get('runner') == RUNNER and r.get('count_for_scientific_coverage') is True and r.get('historical_receipt') == x['historical']
        assert r.get('multiset') == x['multiset'] and r.get('b_index') == x['b_index'] and r.get('indices') == x['indices']
        if x['mode'] == 'partbatch':
            assert r.get('list_sha256') == x['list']['sha256'] and r.get('complete_denominator') == x['list']['n'] and r.get('enumerator') == 'extend_b.py'
        else:
            assert not any(key in r for key in ('list_sha256','complete_denominator','enumerator'))
        if r.get('group_started'): assert (r.get('supervisor') or {}).get('supervisor_sha256') == R.SUP_SHA
        errs = admission_errors(r,epochs(c)[0],r.get('status') == 'UNSAT')
        assert not errs, errs
        if r.get('status') == 'UNSAT':
            assert not r.get('owner_cancelled') and not r.get('observed_signal') and not (r.get('supervisor') or {}).get('observed_signal'), \
                'UNSAT record carries a signal/cancellation'
    except (OSError,ValueError,KeyError,TypeError,AssertionError,StopIteration) as exc:
        return {'state':'INTEGRITY_VETO','errors':[repr(exc)]}
    enc = 'encode_skel_b.build_v2' if x['mode'] == 'direct' else 'encode_skel_b.build_partbatch'
    ex = E.expected(x['multiset'],x['b_index'],x['indices'],pin['cnf_sha256'],pin['cnf_bytes'],enc,x['native_seconds'],False)
    ex.update(binary_authority=c['binary_authority'],lane_root=str(L),source_sha256=c['source_sha256'],recipe=pin['recipe'])
    return E.inspect(L/it['new_record'],ex,k['record_sha256'])


def formula(c,x,skeletons):
    D = skeletons[x['multiset']]; sk = D['skeletons'][x['b_index']]
    special = [p for p in D['profiles'] if list(p) != COMMON.P0]
    if x['mode'] == 'direct':
        nv,cl = ENC.build_v2(D['c0'],[tuple(t) for t in sk['types']],sk['empty'],special)
    else:
        assert E.digest(L/x['list']['path']) == x['list']['sha256']
        ed = COMMON.read(L/x['list']['path']); lo,hi = x['indices']
        assert not list_errors(x,ed)
        nv,cl = ENC.build_partbatch(D['c0'],[tuple(t) for t in sk['types']],sk['empty'],special,[ed['placements'][i] for i in range(lo,hi+1)])
    return ENC.cnf_bytes(nv,cl)


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(); ap.add_argument('contract'); ap.add_argument('sha256'); ap.add_argument('--max-attempts',type=int)
    args = ap.parse_args(); R.install_handlers()
    cut,end,cleanup = epochs()
    logs = L/'cycle2/m2h6_3-chunks'/('%s-%d' % (time.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%S'),time.time_ns())); logs.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
    stage = L/'scratch/m2h-publish'/logs.name
    lock = os.open(L/SINGLETON,os.O_CREAT|os.O_RDWR,0o644)
    try: fcntl.flock(lock,fcntl.LOCK_EX|fcntl.LOCK_NB)
    except BlockingIOError:
        COMMON.publish_json(logs/'singleton-refusal.json',{'status':'REFUSED','reason':'another M2H v6_3 pipeline holds the singleton lock',
            'host_clock':time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z')},stage)
        print('M2H singleton refusal',flush=True); os.close(lock); return
    try:
        run_locked(args,cut,end,cleanup,logs,stage)
    finally:
        fcntl.flock(lock,fcntl.LOCK_UN); os.close(lock)


def run_locked(args,cut,end,cleanup,logs,stage):
    """Body of main() while this process holds the M2H singleton lock."""
    if time.time() >= cut:
        COMMON.publish_json(logs/'admission-closed.json',{'status':'REFUSED','reason':'frozen 17:20 policy admission cutoff reached',
            'host_clock':time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z')},stage)
        print('M2H admission closed by the frozen policy clock',flush=True); return
    deadline = min(time.monotonic()+10800,time.monotonic()+(end-time.time())-cleanup)
    with R.Capacity(deadline,metadata=True,wait_allowance=60):
        st = os.statvfs(L); assert st.f_bavail*st.f_frsize >= R.BASE_GATE+1024**2
        assert E.digest(args.contract) == args.sha256
        c = COMMON.read(args.contract); verify(c)
        union = R.admission_union(L)
        record_vetoes = {x['id']:s for x in c['items'] if (L/task(x)['new_record']).exists()
                         for s in [inspect(c,args.sha256,x)['state']] if s in ('INTEGRITY_VETO','SAT_VETO','HALT_UNKNOWN')}
        if union['persistent_vetoes'] or union['resource_stops'] or record_vetoes:
            COMMON.publish_json(logs/'initialization-deferred.json',{'status':'UNKNOWN','admission_union':union,'record_vetoes':record_vetoes,
                'init_stage':'veto-scan' if (union['persistent_vetoes'] or record_vetoes) else 'resource-stop','native_has_started':False,
                'contract_sha256':args.sha256,'host_clock':time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z')},stage)
            print('M2H initialization refusal',union,record_vetoes,flush=True); return
        assert all(v['matches'] for v in R.binary_observations(c['binary_authority']).values())
        bound = c['resource_policy']['whole_plan_remaining_bound_bytes']
        reference = R.create_census(); census = R.census_for_gate(reference)
        assert census['current_data_upper_bytes']+bound+R.OTHER_WRITER_MARGIN <= R.DATA_CAP
        admission = {'binary_authority':c['binary_authority'],'census_reference':reference,'whole_plan_remaining_bound_bytes':bound,
                     'admission_cutoff_epoch':cut}
        skeletons = {int(k):COMMON.read(L/v['path']) for k,v in c['skeletons'].items()}
    records,attempts,stop = [],0,None
    for x in c['items']:
        if args.max_attempts is not None and attempts >= args.max_attempts: stop = 'operational tranche reached'; break
        if time.time() >= cut: stop = 'admission closed by the frozen 17:20 policy clock'; break
        if R._CANCEL[0] or time.monotonic()+2550 > deadline: stop = 'deadline/cancellation; no new native'; break
        it = task(x)
        if (L/it['new_record']).exists():
            q = inspect(c,args.sha256,x)
            if q['state'] in ('INTEGRITY_VETO','SAT_VETO','HALT_UNKNOWN'): stop = 'existing persistent veto '+x['id']; break
            continue  # every previous UNKNOWN remains; no retry
        if not TX.claim(it['claim'],args.sha256,it['id']): continue

        def build():
            assert E.digest(args.contract) == args.sha256
            verify_sources(c)
            assert not (L/it['new_record']).exists()
            ref = c['skeletons'][str(x['multiset'])]
            assert E.digest(L/ref['path']) == ref['sha256'] and E.digest(L/x['historical']['path']) == x['historical']['sha256']
            raw = formula(c,x,skeletons)
            got = (hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),len(raw))
            if got != (x['expected_cnf_sha256'],x['expected_cnf_bytes']):
                raise OWNER.BindingRefusal('regenerated formula %s/%d differs from bound historical CNF %s/%d' % (got+(x['expected_cnf_sha256'],x['expected_cnf_bytes'])))
            return raw
        paths = TX.item_paths(it,stage)
        try:
            r = OWNER.execute(build,recipe(c,x),args.sha256,c['source_sha256'],paths,deadline,admission,'cadical',x['native_seconds'])
        except BaseException as exc:
            COMMON.publish_json(logs/('owner-exception-'+x['id'].replace(':','_')+'.json'),{'status':'UNKNOWN','reason':repr(exc),'id':x['id']},stage)
            if not (L/it['pin']).exists(): TX.release_unattempted(it['claim'],'M2H owner refused before pin/native')
            stop = 'owner admission/exception'; break
        if r.get('binding_refusal'):
            assert not any(os.path.exists(paths[k]) for k in ('pin','job','supervisor','worker_result','quarantine')), 'binding refusal after a pin/job/group'
            COMMON.publish_json(logs/('binding-refusal-'+x['id'].replace(':','_')+'.json'),{'status':'UNATTEMPTED','id':x['id'],
                'reason':r['binding_refusal'],'no_pin_job_group':True,'veto':None,'host_clock':time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z')},stage)
            TX.release_unattempted(it['claim'],'M2H pre-pin binding refusal; no pin/job/group; no veto'); stop = 'pre-pin binding refusal'; break
        if r.get('unattempted') == 'before-pin' and not (L/it['pin']).exists():
            TX.release_unattempted(it['claim'],'refusal rule1: M2H refused before pin/job; no record or HALT'); stop = 'pre-pin refusal'; break
        if r.get('unattempted') == 'after-pin-before-worker':
            TX.retire_unattempted_after_pin(it,paths,'refusal rule2: M2H refused before worker; no record or HALT'); stop = 'pre-worker refusal'; break
        if not r.get('pre_child_pin_sha256'):
            COMMON.publish_json(logs/('binding-or-construction-'+x['id'].replace(':','_')+'.json'),r,stage)
            TX.release_unattempted(it['claim'],'M2H construction refused before immutable pin/native'); stop = 'construction refusal'; break
        blocked = signal.pthread_sigmask(signal.SIG_BLOCK,{signal.SIGTERM,signal.SIGINT})  # v6_3 publication window
        try:
            if R._CANCEL[0] and not r.get('owner_cancelled'):  # a cancellation after the owner composed the outcome
                r.update(status='UNKNOWN',checked=False,owner_cancelled=True,halt_production=True,chunk_stop=True,
                         safety_veto=list(r.get('safety_veto') or [])+['cancellation before publication'])
                OWNER.persist_veto(r,paths,args.sha256,recipe(c,x))
            r.update(runner=RUNNER,count_for_scientific_coverage=True,historical_receipt=x['historical'])
            if x['mode'] == 'partbatch': r.update(list_sha256=x['list']['sha256'],complete_denominator=x['list']['n'],enumerator='extend_b.py')
            raw = (json.dumps(r,indent=1)+'\n').encode(); rh = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
            COMMON.publish_json(L/it['commit'],{'schema':'PA19-K1-RECEIPT-v6_3','production_contract_sha256':args.sha256,'b_index':x['b_index'],
                'indices':x['indices'],'record_sha256':rh,'pin_sha256':r['pre_child_pin_sha256']},stage)
            COMMON.publish_bytes(L/it['new_record'],raw,stage)  # primary LAST
        finally:
            signal.pthread_sigmask(signal.SIG_SETMASK,blocked)  # a signal in this window now reaches the cancel handler
        attempts += 1
        item = {'id':x['id'],'record':it['new_record'],'sha256':rh,'status':r['status'],'checked':r['checked'],'integrity_status':r['integrity_status'],
                'host_clock':time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z')}
        records.append(item); print(json.dumps(item),flush=True)
        for gate in (r.get('native_result') or {}).get('gates') or []:
            if gate.get('census'): admission['census_reference'] = gate['census']['reference']
        if r.get('sat_candidate') or r.get('integrity_status') == 'INVALID' or r.get('halt_production'): stop = 'persistent veto'; break
        if r.get('chunk_stop'): stop = 'worker admission refusal recorded UNKNOWN; chunk ends'; break
    COMMON.publish_json(logs/'summary.json',{'host_clock':time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z'),'contract_sha256':args.sha256,'attempts':attempts,
        'records':records,'stop_reason':stop,'automatic_retry_allowed':False,'policy_clocks':POLICY_CLOCKS},stage)
    print(logs,flush=True)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
